nodes.rationale: Adopts MVC pattern with Vue.js 3, Bootstrap 5, Firebase BaaS, FullCalendar 6, jsPDF, and SheetJS for zero-build client-side reactivity and cloud persistence.

nodes.label: MVC Architectural Rules
nodes.rationale: Strict architectural separation: Models alone communicate with Firestore/Auth; Views and Vue handle UI; Controllers coordinate business logic; Core provides shared utilities.
